 Order

Dated this the 19th day of December, 2025 Petitioners are the accused persons 1 to 3 involved in CC.
No.3249/2009 on the file of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Ernakulam, now re-numbered as LP No.46/2016.

The offence alleged against the petitioners is under Sectin 498A r/w 34 of IPC.
2.

The prosecution case is that the 1 st accused being the husband of the defacto complainant and other accused persons being his relatives subjected her to cruelty both physically and mentally on the ground of dowry and thereby they are alleged to have committed the aforesaid offences.
3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioners, the entire dispute between the defacto complainant and the petitioners were settled as per Annexure C to H.
As per the terms of the compromise, both the parties agreed to put an end to all the disputes including the present criminal case against the petitioners.

sentences.text: 4. It is submitted that the defacto complainant and her father are no more.
Respondents 3 and 4 in the MC are the mother and brother of the defacto complainant.
Though notice was served on them, they did not turn up.

Since the entire dispute between the petitioner and the defacto complainant were already settled, this Criminal M.C. is liable to be allowed and all further proceedings against the petitioner in CC. No.3249/2009 on the file of the Chief 2025:KER:98204 Judicial Magistrate Court, Ernakulam is liable to be quashed.
5.
In the result, this Crl. M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner in CC.
No.3249/2009 on the file of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Ernakulam, now re-numbered as LP No.46/2016 arising from crime No.767/2009 of Ernakulam Town South Police Station, stands quashed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE sou.
